overview_description.description: Tenet Industries designs and manufactures low-cost, mass-manufacturable strike drones. The company develops proprietary software and purpose-built hardware for unmanned aerial systems used in defense applications. Tenet Industries focuses on design-for-manufacturing and first principles engineering to produce kamikaze drones, deepstrike drones, and missiles. Its offerings are intended for organizations that require scalable strike capabilities and rapid deployment of unmanned systems. The company provides demonstrations of its systems to prospective defense customers and partners.
